Name: Weak Mummies
Author: penny3
Description:
Hey, you know what's annoying? When you hit a mummy five times and you finally kill it... and then it gets back up ten seconds later.

I don't know how to make them stop getting back up without wasting my precious bombs. But I do know how to make them super weak. Now you just whack them once and they'll fall and sit around for ten seconds. Then they'll get back up and you can knock them back down.

In more technical terms, this mod uses Content Patcher to edit the Monsters.xnb file so that the mummies' base HP is 1. It should be compatible with all mods, except those that also edit the "Mummy" line in the Monsters.xnb file. Just extract the file into your mods folder.
